subject.title: [Feature]: Allow job-level model override for cron jobs using sessionTarget=main + payload.kind=systemEvent

question: Should OpenClaw support a first-class per-job model/provider override for `sessionTarget: "main"` plus `payload.kind: "systemEvent"` cron jobs, and if so should the contract be `payload.model`, a top-level cron job field, or an explicit `sessionOverride` block?
rationale: Current code intentionally makes systemEvent text-only and model selection is tied to agentTurn/session state; changing that affects provider routing, session state, and wake-mode behavior that repository policy treats as product-sensitive.

options.title: Design explicit systemEvent override contract
options.body: Approve one durable API shape, require allowlist validation and scoped lifetime semantics, and then implement/runtime-test both wake modes before closing this issue.

options.title: Keep systemEvent model-free
options.body: Decide that systemEvent only queues main-session context and should not pick models, then close or update docs to direct model-specific scheduled work to agentTurn jobs.

options.title: Defer into broader cron schema redesign
options.body: Hold this issue behind the broader cron tool/API schema direction if maintainers want one unified model-facing cron contract first.

recommendation.title: Design explicit systemEvent override contract
recommendation.body: Approve one durable API shape, require allowlist validation and scoped lifetime semantics, and then implement/runtime-test both wake modes before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue needs a product/API boundary decision across cron runtime, session state, and recent Control UI scoping, and steipete has the strongest combined history and review signal in those areas.
